summary: Retest of the fixes from iteration_84 (Chez Dina final audit §15). Backend: new file test_final_audit_15_retest.py (17 tests) plus the previous suites, with test_2 in the e2e file updated to the new scanned_qty contract. All 41 tests pass. UI tested with Playwright on desktop 1920, tablet 1024x768 and 768x1024, and mobile 390. Every fix listed in the request works. Three new issues found: (1) order items carry no 'sku' (0 of 630 orders), so scanning the real product SKU or barcode answers 'Code inconnu' and only the product UUID can be scanned; (2) the manual-override reason and scanned_items are not stored on the order or in audit_log; (3) one old cash session (validated before the closed=True fix) is still closed=False, so it shows as 'Session en cours' and hides the 'Ouvrir une session' button. All TEST data was deleted and stock of DEMO-100 restored exactly.

feature_table.fix: Store sku (and barcode/ean) on items at order creation (public, POS, AI, console), or enrich items with the product SKU in GET /orders or in PrepRunner (load the products), or match against the product's SKU and variant SKU (DEMO-100-39)

action_items: HIGH: Put sku (plus variant SKU/barcode) on order items at creation, or enrich them for PrepRunner, so a real SKU/barcode scan matches (today only the product UUID works)
Save scanned_items and the manual override reasons in update_order_status_v3 (order.prep_scan plus timeline/audit_log)
Migrate old cash_sessions with status validated/gap and closed != true to closed=True (session 36f814ab... is blocking 'Ouvrir une session')
Optional: hide or lock the size stock table in ProductFormV3 when variants exist; size/colour picker after paste-wa-pick; remove ?coller=1 on close; restock on retournee if that is the business rule
critical_code_review_comments: PrepRunner.matches splits the scan on whitespace and '_', so colours with spaces ('Rose poudré', 'Vert émeraude') can never match in SKU|taille|couleur format; split only on '|'
require_role lets sales inherit manager: GET /products/{pid} (and the GET /products list) exposes cost to the vendeuse; strip cost for sales if that is sensitive
ProductFormV3 save sends {...f} (the whole document, including rating fields and created_at); send a whitelist instead
_restock_order runs for any cancel, including orders whose stock was never decremented (e.g. old or seeded orders without a stock movement); consider a 'stock_reserved' flag
